title: The agentic web is here
hook_text: Tim Berners-Lee predicted autonomous AI in 2001.
script:
Tim Berners-Lee imagined an internet designed for autonomous software agents in 2001.
He published a Scientific American article outlining the Semantic Web with his colleagues.
The article described software agents addressing our every need across the internet.
Autonomous AI can now handle complex multi step tasks across web applications.
These software agents are built to execute complex workflows without human intervention.
Developers are now deploying these systems to interact directly with web APIs and browsers.
Would you trust software to navigate your daily digital life?
